title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: The inner side of the right ankle and foot, leg rolled outward: leg up out of the top, toes to the left, heel at the lower right, Achilles tendon up the right edge. The sural positioning view mirrored to the medial side; camera after NYSORA's tibial photo (concept only).
teachingPoint: The probe lies transverse in the groove between the medial malleolus and the Achilles tendon, just above the malleolar tip; the needle enters in line with it from the back.
claims: Right foot externally rotated so the medial side faces up (record: supine, foot externally rotated).
Probe transverse behind the medial malleolus, its face spanning the groove between the malleolus and the Achilles tendon (record).
Needle in-plane from the posterior (Achilles) end of the probe, as on the section plate (record: in-plane; NYSORA: posterior end).
Labels: Medial malleolus, Achilles tendon, Linear probe, Block needle.

geometry.why: Achilles behind the malleolus (posterior on the right)
probe just above the malleolar tip
needle beside, in line with, the probe
